name: May Ziadeh
contribution: A Lebanese-Palestinian Maronite poet, essayist, and translator, who wrote many different works both in Arabic and in French.

checks.lead: May Elias Ziadeh ( zee-AH-də; Arabic: مي إلياس زيادة, ALA-LC: Mayy Ilyās Ziyādah; 11 February 1886 – 17 October 1941) was a Lebanese-Palestinian Maronite poet, essayist, and translator, who wrote many different works both in Arabic and in French.
